account.changePasswordComment: The account-edit form with the change-password box already ticked. The plain edit form renders the three password fields hidden, so the tests would have nothing to fill.
account.editAccountComment: The account-edit form. There is deliberately no changeEmail variant of it: Magento's Account\Edit controller honours a `changepass` parameter and has no equivalent for email, so the change-email box is ticked by the page object instead.

products.secondaryProductComment: A second, different in-stock product PDP. Must match fixtures.product.secondaryProductTitle.
products.outOfStockProductComment: PDP of the product the seed keeps out of stock. Must match fixtures.product.outOfStock.urlKey plus the store's catalog/seo/product_url_suffix.
products.adminEditableProductComment: PDP of the product the admin edit-and-save test renames. Must match fixtures.product.adminEditable.urlKey plus the store's catalog/seo/product_url_suffix. Renaming a product does not regenerate its URL key, so this stays valid while the test holds the temporary name.
products.virtualProductComment: PDP of the virtual product the seed creates. Must match fixtures.product.virtual.urlKey plus the store's catalog/seo/product_url_suffix.
products.bundleProductComment: PDP of the bundle the seed creates. Must match fixtures.product.bundle.urlKey plus the store's catalog/seo/product_url_suffix.

notFoundComment: A URL guaranteed not to resolve, used to prove the store still serves its 404 page.

categories.pagedListingPageComment: A category listing with MORE visible products than `inputs.category.listingPage.resultsPerPage`, so the limiter can actually reach that tile count and the pager has a second page to go to. `listingPage` above is deliberately a small category (it exists to be filtered), which is why these two are separate slugs.
categories.parentListingPageComment: An ANCHOR category that has children, used to prove Magento rolls a child's products up into its parent. Defaults to the same category as pagedListingPage because the stock sample data's `Tops` is both, but they are separate keys: a store whose paged category happens to be a leaf still needs somewhere to point this.
categories.childOfParentListingPageComment: A category that is a CHILD of parentListingPage. Its products must appear in the parent's listing (the assertion is 'at least one', because the parent's first page holds fewer products than the branch).

guestOrderLookupComment: Orders and Returns. The only route a guest has to an order they placed without an account.

reviews.gridComment: Marketing > Reviews. Deliberately the ALL-reviews grid rather than /review/product/pending/: the pending grid would make 'the review is awaiting moderation' true by construction, while filtering the full grid and reading the Status column back proves it.

orders.newComment: The Create New Order entry point. `order_create/start` clears any half-built order left in the admin session and redirects to the form, so a test never inherits another run's quote.
